answer: Shell reported total gross Scope 3 emissions of 1,065 MtCO2e in 2025 and 1,084 MtCO2e in 2024; Category 11 use of sold products was 836 and 845 MtCO2e, respectively. Scope 3 is prepared on an equity boundary, not operational control. The related biogenic CO2 excluded from Category 11 was estimated at 32 MtCO2 in 2025 and 29 MtCO2 in 2024. Therefore the figures must not be relabelled as operational-control emissions or as including biogenic CO2.

normalized_value.caution: not operational-control emissions; biogenic CO2 is excluded

evidence.quote: Indirect biogenic emissions of CO2 not included in Scope 3 emissions ... 2025 32; 2024 29
